home.introduce: After seven years of R&D, our core team created China’s first “Blockchain as Government -- GAChain”: a blockchain infrastructure with an all-new architecture and fully proprietary intellectual property. It lets you create independently running scenarios on-chain with fully tiered management permissions, feed external data into GAChain smart contracts, and achieve efficient, precise automated transaction processing that unites on-chain and off-chain data. Our goal is to make complex technology simple, creating more value and capability for governments and enterprises as they integrate resources and business applications.
home.idea: Centralized management with decentralized business is the core design philosophy of GAChain.
home.idea1: Blockchain must be application-driven and management-centered, meeting the governance requirements of government information systems and enterprises, while also decentralizing business operations to meet market demand.
home.idea2: Unlike distributed storage on other chains, GAChain uses multiple node types. The data they store is like a multi-dimensional puzzle that can be broken apart and reassembled at will.
home.idea21: Accounts and transactions are secured with the secp256k1 elliptic curve algorithm. We also support China’s national cryptographic standards and other algorithms such as RSA, AES and DES.
home.idea3: The VDE node is one of GAChain’s major technical innovations.
home.idea31: Blockchains have long struggled with using data off-chain and exchanging data across chains. VDE nodes make off-chain interaction with many forms of data possible.
home.idea32: We also provide a matching consensus mechanism to keep off-chain and on-chain data consistent and valid.
home.idea4: A blockchain with a built-in database is one of GAChain’s major technical innovations.
home.idea41: Blockchain has long been criticized for sacrificing too much performance for decentralization. GAChain’s built-in database eliminates repeated reads of core application data, boosting chain performance while preserving full decentralization.
home.idea42: We believe this is where blockchain technology is headed.
home.idea5: Unlike other blockchains that rely on oracles, GAChain writes smart contracts in GALANG, a language we developed in-house.
home.idea51: Smart contracts are fair, impartial and confirm rights by vote, making transaction processing on GAChain far more convenient while improving efficiency and performance.
home.idea6: Government information processing must leave an audit trail that cannot be altered. Even a well-built centralized database cannot fully prevent later tampering.
home.idea61: Blockchain’s decentralized, distributed storage naturally prevents data from being tampered with after the fact. Because every action is recorded on-chain, government processes leave a complete audit trail and every action becomes traceable.
home.idea7: Messages sent through conventional communication tools are not secure: they can be intercepted in transit, or even misused by the very servers that relay them.
home.idea71: Blockchain transmits data peer-to-peer, with no servers in between; the two parties exchange information directly. SHA256 encryption adds another layer of protection, keeping data secure and reliable.
home.idea8: Collaborative work must solve two problems: storing one’s own files and documents, and collecting and editing documents from multiple parties.
home.idea81: GAChain smart contracts support both single-party and multi-party rights confirmation of data, ensuring security and integrity while making data sharing and exchange possible.
home.appear: They will bring convenience to every sector, lower the cost of blockchain applications and deliver more complete system solutions
home-base: Our BaaS platform integrates the chain’s core configuration, so no specialist blockchain developers are needed for custom development. Core chain features can be configured in a short time, saving you time and making blockchain applications more efficient.
home.trade: Build an industry-specific SaaS ecosystem for every sector, improving management efficiency and driving higher revenue
home.open: Open platform APIs with real-time data access and seamless third-party integration
home.go: GAChain’s technology stack is developed entirely in-house. The chain’s core is written in Go. The SaaS platform front end uses GAStyle, which accurately validates contract feasibility and pinpoints problems for developers. The SaaS back end uses GALang, which is quicker to master and put into real-world use than other languages.
home.sha: The Nansha Administrative Approval Platform was built at the request of the Nansha District Government of Guangzhou. As Nansha’s first blockchain pilot project, it has made administrative approvals more efficient, streamlined approval workflows, strengthened the district’s e-government management, and standardized the oversight of intermediaries, staff and case progress.
home.sha1: By improving efficiency and data transparency, blockchain can transform how business flows through e-government systems and drive their upgrade. It is better suited to today’s e-government needs in unified office work, intelligent management, workflow, open trust, performance evaluation, information security, breaking down data silos and disaster recovery.
home.wangyi: NetEase Tokyo, also known as “Gold Concierge”, serves the 800,000 Chinese living in Japan. It helps Chinese students in Japan with housing, moving, daily necessities, appliances and furniture through at-home services, and helps those about to study in Japan with visas and admissions. Dedicated “tantō” provide guidance, saving students time and helping them avoid detours. Think of it as a “Dianping for a small city”, with one difference: Dianping promotes merchants, while we promote people, the tantō (a Japanese term roughly meaning “account representative” or “account manager”).
home.info: This business model is built on information and trust. Unlike a centralized application, all NetEase Tokyo data is anonymized, encrypted and stored on the blockchain. Services provided by tantō and by the platform, historical price changes, service adjustments and user reviews are all open and verifiable. Staying transparent to users and fair to tantō had long troubled the project team, until GAChain from Shenzhen GAChain solved every one of these problems.

product.gochain: GAChain is an independent, self-developed blockchain framework refined over 7 years. With proprietary intellectual property, a large team of blockchain engineers and mastery of core blockchain technology, we are ready to support blockchain development and research for government and business.
product.base: Built on GAChain, Shenzhen GAChain offers an open, independent ecosystem that helps businesses move onto the chain and complete their blockchain transformation quickly.
product.govis: Our own smart contract platform, GOVIS, provides government and enterprise users with standard open interfaces and an SDK. Blockchain contracts are like interior furnishing: you design different features to fit your own needs.
product.tps: GAChain is a complete, independent chain designed around the modernization of government information. Node control, node permission rules, throughput (TPS), transaction fees and base contracts can all be configured, letting you build a brand-new chain quickly.
product.cooperation: Shenzhen GAChain welcomes partners with an open mind and is willing to open its core chain technology to partners under agreed terms, advancing blockchain applications and exploration together.
product.unite: Combining blockchain with traditional technology keeps business running smoothly while securing data and lowering the cost of connecting data.
product.hash: Blockchain hash-based tamper resistance, smart contracts and consensus mechanisms deliver an efficient, low-cost security system.
product.code: When hackers or criminals attack the database, the system computes the file hash and compares it with the hash stored on GAChain. If they differ, an alarm is triggered and staff are notified immediately to respond.
product.security: Trusted, secure storage: department data stays authentic and secure, and key information can never be altered or lost
product.government: Governments hold 80% of society’s data, stored in databases designated by government departments. These are enormous yet highly centralized systems, more vulnerable to cyberattacks than distributed systems, where a single point of failure can cause massive losses. Forged or tampered data also has many negative consequences. GAChain helps protect public information and keep government data secure.
product.government1: GAChain’s secp256k1 encryption and China’s national cryptographic algorithms effectively prevent forgery and tampering. As a public blockchain system, GAChain lets every participant in the peer-to-peer network read and store data. Every create, read, update or delete operation is synchronized across the entire authorized network, so any attempt to tamper with or delete information is rendered invalid.
product.core: Trusted traceability for core business: 60% fewer errors
product.time: The “block storage + chained timestamp” data structure provides a permanent, traceable and complete chain of data. You can trace records back to their source and verify every result, while block records and timestamps serve as proof of existence, forming evidence that cannot be altered or forged.
product.credible: Trusted business integration: break down data silos and boost government efficiency by 50%
product.department: Traditional government departments are organized as top-down hierarchies based on scope of authority and degree of control, with administrative decisions implemented from the top down. Such hierarchies have long been criticized for rigid controls and slow responses. Slow and distorted information flow between levels undermines administrative effectiveness, especially during public emergencies, whose suddenness and uncertainty put a government’s judgment and responsiveness to the test.
product.department1: With GAChain’s P2P technology, events, activities and information related to public affairs and governance can be spread or verified widely in a short time. Instructions from higher-level departments can bypass intermediate levels and reach grassroots departments directly and quickly in line with a shared consensus system, while key information sent directly from grassroots departments can be collected just as fast, ensuring information is timely and authentic. GAChain handles the massive exchange and processing of information between levels, speeding up information flow, bringing levels closer together and reducing administrative layers, creating a more compact and flatter organizational structure within government.
product.change: Government data sharing and exchange is a key administrative policy long promoted in China. Traditional sharing and exchange still relies on centralized systems, where data collection, reading and storage all happen in a central system, creating risks of data leaks. Permission management in centralized systems is relatively insecure: authorization by directory structure and item is incomplete, and unauthorized reads or improper calls happen frequently.
product.change1: Built on a zero-trust principle, blockchain establishes a complete system of mutual trust through distributed storage, smart contracts, cross-organization authorization and tamper-proof audit trails. Once the directory system and data structure are in place, data is stored by permission level across the nodes of management agencies at different levels. Smart contract triggers and cross-organization authorization retrieve exactly the target data, and elliptic curve encryption protects data in transit against leaks. The entire process leaves a tamper-proof trail for later review.
product.change2: Only a blockchain-based sharing and exchange system is truly complete, and Shenzhen GAChain has prepared a comprehensive solution for it. Designed for government information sharing, GAChain also solves paid access and paid sharing in commercial settings. Its decentralized audit trail prevents inconsistent or falsified data, and we welcome partnerships with enterprises in commercial data sharing and exchange.
product.info: Information Resource Sharing and Exchange Platform
product.build: A data resource sharing platform that acts as the blockchain master node, storing the core data for sharing and exchange.
product.fen: N thematic databases built by department and business line, such as legal entity, case processing and population exchange databases. Each acts as a child node storing its own data awaiting exchange.
product.catalog: Directory management, data collection, data exchange, data integration and exchange management systems. Acting as regular blockchain nodes, they store data in the corresponding departments or business units.
product.mou: Sample resource directory of a government data exchange platform
product.system: A security framework and a standards framework. Data reads and triggers pass through blockchain smart contracts, ensuring data is secure and accurate and preventing improper or unauthorized access.
product.we: Building on our success in government, we are also seeking partnerships with businesses, combining our strengths to develop and promote blockchain applications together. If you are interested in GAChain, please get in touch.
product.we1: GAChain keeps exploring: integrated government and business ecosystems, shared users and traffic, and multi-dimensional, multi-level technological synergy.
service.title: Great Value Deserves Open Sharing!
service.text: Blockchain technology is still maturing, and we press forward with a commitment to independent R&D. We have never lost our way on this journey and remain steadfast in our beliefs: humble in success, grateful for recognition and open to criticism. Every technical breakthrough, patent and software copyright is the result of our team’s hard work. In a spirit of openness and sharing, we work with developers in China and around the world to advance blockchain technology.
service.gachain: Shenzhen GAChain has built a complete technology system around blockchain and GAChain applications
service.save: The node with the highest authority on the chain. It stores the full data set and is created by the initialization contract or elected by later vote. Acting as GAChain’s administrator and supervisor, it keeps the chain running and packages and distributes business data.
service.source: The source of business activity and the creator of data.
service.source1: The large volume of business data produced by regular nodes is submitted on-chain for validation via the consensus mechanism. They hold no special identity on the chain, yet they are the most important nodes.
service.first: Child nodes are sensitive and private. From the start, we believed everyone deserves their own secrets, and the same is true in government: key data in classified departments is not made public and is visible only to those with limited permissions.
service.first1: And so the child node was born.
service.move: This algorithm seeks broader online validation. When a new block is produced, an optimal solution is selected, and it takes effect only after approval by N online validators.
service.move1: This mechanism ensures that liars are never endorsed by the majority.
service.careful: We carefully weighed how to avoid wasting resources while adding computing power. Proof of capacity is reusable and the most cost-effective option.
service.careful1: This consensus algorithm requires only storage space, which can be reused, making it the most energy-efficient and eco-friendly approach.
service.on: Across GAChain we always emphasize centralized management with decentralized business, and proof of stake solves this perfectly.
service.data1: For large data, we usually store a HASH mapping on-chain. The more secure GFils storage option is also available.
service.data2: If you need more capacity, we would be glad to hear from you. This will never stand in the way of our cooperation.
service.second: At 2000 TPS, GAChain runs very stably. Slight fluctuations appear at 3000 TPS, speed drops by 25% at 4000 TPS, and queuing occurs at 5000 TPS. Figures recorded on March 1, 2020.
service.second1: There is much more we are doing and plan to do, and we never stop improving overall performance. We believe GAChain’s throughput will multiply in the near future.
service.gavic: GOVIS is one of our proudest creations. It combines ecosystem management and maintenance in one platform and, most importantly, offers online smart contract editing.
service.cross: Cross-chain, off-chain access and data sharing have recently become hot topics, but we began researching the VDE (virtual machine) mechanism back in 2017. Data security concerns make blockchains “closed” and “isolated”, and in real projects we kept running into the same problems: how to access off-chain data securely, how to share and exchange data, and even how to move data across chains.
service.oracle: VDE (virtual machine) nodes act as blockchain oracles and can be seen as the chain’s “bastion host”, enabling secure external access to chain applications and data, and open sharing of anonymized data.
service.oracle1: On-chain data sharing has its own authorization mechanism triggered by smart contracts, making access rights easier to confirm and data supervision transparent. Off-chain open data sharing has its own anonymization and disclosure mechanism.
service.oracle2: External requests for on-chain data go through limited-permission access that leaves on-chain data unaffected, keeping open data independent and on-chain data secure. When the chain needs off-chain data, smart contracts can access it under the consensus algorithm, store it, and convert it into on-chain data.
service.github: Explore more of GAChain’s technology on GitHub.
solution.text: On our blockchain journey, we have explored many directions and built up a wide range of blockchain solutions with our partners. If you have a better blockchain application, a more interesting idea or a more viable project, talk to our team. We would be glad to work with you and provide professional blockchain solutions.
solution.content1:
An app for the 800,000 Chinese living in Japan. Local Chinese students serve as “tantō”, offering end-to-end services such as accommodation, home living, travel and dining to Chinese arriving in Japan to study or on business.
Blockchain makes the information more authentic: every tantō’s profile can be checked on-chain, openly and transparently. All service records and reviews are genuine, eliminating the fake data common in centralized systems and building user trust.
solution.content2:
Connected vehicles face three major challenges:
1. Insufficient cross-department collaboration and data sharing;
2. Challenges in industry development;
3. Information security risks.
Blockchain offers three corresponding solutions:
1. Cross-department collaboration to advance connected vehicles;
2. Concentrated efforts on breakthroughs in key technologies to drive industrialization;
3. Strong protection of connected-vehicle information security.
solution.content3: IoT applications powered by 5G are on the rise, bringing new opportunities and change to many industries. How can we seize these opportunities today and better use blockchain to empower IoT?
solution.content4:
In some cities, data between the medical insurance bureau and local healthcare providers cannot be connected in real time. Data tampering and security issues are common, and the lack of coordinated planning and unified supervision leaves gray areas for corruption.
Blockchain’s transparency, tamper resistance and encrypted transmission can connect medical insurance systems with local healthcare providers (HIS systems), enabling effective supervision and real-time data reporting.
solution.content5: A data-driven approach to modern urban management. With closed-loop coordination, data is used within the city and connected beyond it, building an integrated data center for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and high-level data models that provide the data foundation for talent mobility, economic flows, business conditions and public security.
solution.content6:
With rapid advances in IT, maturing e-invoicing, ubiquitous smart devices, increasingly active trade and rising expectations for service quality, the socialized tax collection model, in which post offices, sub-district offices and insurers collect taxes on the government’s behalf, faces major challenges.
We have made many improvements in using blockchain for paperless invoices that are verifiable, tamper-proof and protected against duplicate claims.
solution.content7: China’s exports grow every year, yet cross-border trade settlement remains a persistent obstacle to international trade.
solution.content8: To implement the State Council’s Action Plan for Promoting Big Data Development and the national big data strategy, and in line with the 13th Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development and the 13th Five-Year National Informatization Plan, which call for stronger top-level design and tiered development of new smart cities, we have created an industry-academia-research integration solution with blockchain at its core.
solution.content9:
Film crowdfunding spreads costs and risks, letting film lovers take part in the entire process of shooting, production, distribution and release. As owners and beneficiaries of the work, backers further promote the film and share its highlights, maximizing its value.
Blockchain confirms the rights of box office backers, allowing box office shares to trade on the market like futures and to be redeemed for screenings with tokens after release.
This will be a landmark change in the history of cinema.
solution.content10:
We offer a complete product for government information sharing and exchange, as well as data sharing cases for enterprises.
In a trustless environment, traditional centralized interfaces often suffer from falsified data and inflated figures. Blockchain’s transparency and resistance to forgery and tampering effectively prevent false data.
about.title: GAChain
about.text:
An independent, controllable blockchain infrastructure framework
Built on centralized management with decentralized business
about.team1: After seven years of dedicated R&D, our core team created China’s first “Blockchain as Government -- GAChain”: a blockchain infrastructure with an all-new architecture and fully proprietary intellectual property. It lets you create independently running scenarios on-chain with fully tiered management permissions, feed external data into GAChain smart contracts, and achieve efficient, precise automated transaction processing that unites on-chain and off-chain data. Our goal is to make complex technology simple, creating more value and capability for governments and enterprises as they integrate resources and business applications.
about.team2: Shenzhen GAChain has long been an industry leader in blockchain R&D and applications. Our self-developed SaaS blockchain system follows a model of centralized management and decentralized business, in line with China’s goal of a more scientific and standardized government administration. Starting from government needs, it is built on the principles of information security, distributed storage and controlled data sharing, with a friendly, intuitive and easy-to-use experience, and developed in our own proprietary languages.
about.team3: As of March 1, 2020, GAChain had obtained more than 40 patents and software copyrights. A key project reviewed by China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, GAChain was featured as a typical use case in the 2018 China Blockchain Industry White Paper.
